description: Signed up before the first puck dropped. Le Council has your name on file. This is neither a threat nor a promise.

description: One of the first five hundred to answer. Le Council has a list. You are on it.

name: Council-Met
description: Met a member of Le Council in person. What was discussed remains glacified. What was felt remains unexplained.

name: First Wager
description: Placed your very first bet. The Ice approves of commitment, even uninformed commitment.
svg: <svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 256 256" fill="none"><path fill="none" d="M0 0h256v256H0z"></path><circle cx="128" cy="96" r="80" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="16"></circle><circle cx="128" cy="96" r="48" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="16"></circle><path fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="16" d="M176 160v80l-48.01-24L80 240v-79.99"></path></svg>

description: Placed 50 bets. At this point, Le Council considers you a recurring line item.

description: Placed 500 bets. Le Council does not judge. Le Council does, however, take notes.

description: Won 5 bets in a row. Skill or coincidence. The Ice does not distinguish.

description: Won 10 bets in a row. O.D.D.S. would like a word. Several words, actually.

description: Set down one Idol and raised another. The first one was told. It does not take questions.

description: Participated in Season 3. Three seasons of the same ice, and it still has not told anyone what it wants.

description: Held a fortune the night someone spilled coffee on The Jambono. It resurfaced more than the ice. The higher the stack, the deeper the shave. We apologize.

description: Spent 25 S.T.A.M.P.S. across petitions. Le Council notes a pattern of civic participation. This is filed as a compliment.

name: Seal-Bearer
description: Spent 100 S.T.A.M.P.S. You have never missed a day you could help it. L'Agence has never asked you to.

description: Spent 365 S.T.A.M.P.S. over your lifetime — a full year's worth of endorsement, one administrative day at a time. Le Council recommends rest. Le Council does not expect you to take it.
svg: <svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3.85 8.62a4 4 0 0 1 4.78-4.77 4 4 0 0 1 6.74 0 4 4 0 0 1 4.78 4.78 4 4 0 0 1 0 6.74 4 4 0 0 1-4.77 4.78 4 4 0 0 1-6.75 0 4 4 0 0 1-4.78-4.77 4 4 0 0 1 0-6.76Z"></path><path d="m9 12 2 2 4-4"></path></svg>

name: Frequent Seller
description: Sold shares 50 separate times. The curve moved because you moved it.
svg: <svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M2.7 10.3a2.41 2.41 0 0 0 0 3.41l7.59 7.59a2.41 2.41 0 0 0 3.41 0l7.59-7.59a2.41 2.41 0 0 0 0-3.41L13.7 2.71a2.41 2.41 0 0 0-3.41 0Z"></path><path d="M9.2 9.2h.01"></path><path d="m14.5 9.5-5 5"></path><path d="M14.7 14.8h.01"></path></svg>

name: Profit-Taker
description: Sold shares 100 times. Conviction in, conviction out. S.L.U.S.H. calls this liquidity. Le Council calls it nerves.
svg: <svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M13 17V9"></path><path d="M18 17v-3"></path><path d="M3 3v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h16"></path><path d="M8 17V5"></path></svg>

name: The Exit Strategist
description: Sold shares 500 times. Graine Wetsky Funds has asked S.L.U.S.H., politely, what you know that they don't.
svg: <svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 18H4a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h16a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v5"></path><path d="m16 19 3 3 3-3"></path><path d="M18 12h.01"></path><path d="M19 16v6"></path><path d="M6 12h.01"></path><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="2"></circle></svg>

name: Majority Owner
description: Held 50% or more of a team's issued shares. The fixed pool has a new plurality. Graine Wetsky Funds has taken notice. Le Council has taken notes.
svg: <svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 256 256" fill="none"><rect width="256" height="256" fill="none"></rect><circle cx="76" cy="188" r="28" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="16"></circle><line x1="48" y1="72" x2="88" y2="112" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="16"></line><line x1="88" y1="72" x2="48" y2="112" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="16"></line><line x1="184" y1="168" x2="224" y2="208" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="16"></line><line x1="224" y1="168" x2="184" y2="208" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="16"></line><polyline points="144 80 144 40 184 40" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="16"></polyline><path d="M144,40l16,16c40,40,8,88-24,96" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="16"></path></svg>

name: First Blister
description: Broke the seal on your first blister. La Confrérie prints; it does not appraise. What The Ice put inside is not its affair.
svg: <svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12.832 8.445a1 1 0 00-1.589-.098l-2.075 3.098a1 1 0 000 1.11l2 3a1 1 0 001.664 0l2-3a1 1 0 000-1.11z"/><rect x="5" y="2" width="14" height="20" rx="2"/></svg>

name: Fifty Sealed
description: Opened fifty blisters. Three hundred cards struck on your account alone. La Confrérie has filed every plate and offers no comment on the habit.
svg: <svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M14.832 8.445a1 1 0 00-1.589-.098l-2.075 3.098a1 1 0 000 1.11l2 3a1 1 0 001.664 0l2-3a1 1 0 000-1.11z"/><path d="m7.18 20.827-5-11a2 2 0 01.993-2.647L7 5.44"/><rect x="7" y="2" width="14" height="20" rx="2"/></svg>

name: First Legendary
description: Pulled your first Legendary. One card in forty, and every team is owed exactly one — so somebody's best player is now yours to keep or to trade.
svg: <svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 5 13.7 9.65 18.66 9.84 14.76 12.9 16.11 17.66 12 14.9 7.89 17.66 9.24 12.9 5.34 9.84 10.3 9.65Z"/></svg>

name: Struck in Foil
description: Pulled a Legendary in foil. One card in four thousand, and worth five blisters at the scrap counter. La Confrérie logged the plate and said nothing. Everyone else will.
svg: <svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 5 13.7 9.65 18.66 9.84 14.76 12.9 16.11 17.66 12 14.9 7.89 17.66 9.24 12.9 5.34 9.84 10.3 9.65Z"/><path d="M3.5 2.5v3"/><path d="M2 4h3"/><path d="M20.5 18.5v3"/><path d="M19 20h3"/></svg>

name: The Wall
description: Filled a binder to the last slot. A fan who does not wish to acquire more must decide what to keep — the petition said so before you found out it meant you.
